title: Washington DC and Minneapolis confusion

goal: Book a ride from home to an airport for a trip to Washington DC and ask which airport serves DC.
opening_line: Now I need a ride to the airport. I'm going to Washington DC.

turns.caller: I'm in Minneapolis. Leaving Monday the 18th, early. Pickup at five thirty.
Which airport do I go to here in Minneapolis? Is it the one everyone uses?

branches.caller: Yeah okay. And where do I land in Washington? Which airport is that?

turns.caller: Don't tell me the letters, I never get those. The name.
Pick me up at 123 Main Street, Edina.
Will somebody call me back to confirm?

curveballs: Asks about two metros in one call
expected: Names the Minneapolis airport by full name
